findings: Site-builder template with leftovers: the header shows placeholder contact details "555-555-5555" and "mymail@mailservice.com" on every page.
The Menu page still has the template slider text ("Breathtaking colors of our planet", "Faces of Humanity", "Sands of Time", "Beyond Boundaries") and a row of unlabeled "Button" buttons.
Instagram and Yelp icons point to the generic instagram.com and yelp.com/biz/ pages instead of the shop's profiles; a WhatsApp link is wired to the landline.
No online ordering; "L ike and Follow us" typo in the footer; the address block repeats three times in the header; the Location page says "Add your custom HTML here" instead of a map.
The best content (flat $4 delivery with no DoorDash/Uber fees, specials, seasonal hours) is buried in plain text.
questions: Is delivery still flat $4 to Gilford and Laconia only? Any minimum order, and what hours does delivery run? (The old site says times are approximate and not guaranteed.)
Do you want online ordering? There is none today, so every Order button calls (603) 528-7788. If you use or want a system (Toast, OrderCounter, Slice, etc.) send the link and we will wire it in.
Please confirm seasonal hours: fall/winter (Labor Day to Memorial Day weekend) Mon-Thu 11-8, Fri-Sat 11-9, Sun 12-8; spring/summer Mon-Thu 11-9, Fri-Sat 11-10, Sun 12-9.
Delivery fee comparison: the "What did the app charge you?" tool lets customers type their own app fee. Are you comfortable naming DoorDash and Uber, as your current site does?
Is tax 8.5% still correct? The calculator uses 8.5% (from the old site).

The photos on the current site are category tiles with the category name baked into the picture, and we do not know if they are your own photos. Can you send real photos of your food and the shop? The logo and tiles came from your current site.
What is your email address and your real Instagram and Yelp links? The old site shows placeholders.
The old chips list has stray prices ($10.00, $8) we could not match to an item; please check the drinks and chips prices.
